derivation: All actions are nonnegative integers and probabilities are nonnegative.
For a fixed action sequence, every changed purchase payment and every cumulative expenditure is at least the base value.
Physical/information/terminal inventory constraints are identical. Changed weekly cash is never greater, so each variant-feasible policy is base-feasible, including terminal nonnegative cash.
Variant objective is at least its base objective. The registered base lower bound therefore remains a valid lower bound for the variant.
trust: Inherits the original trusted-native integer bound; this proof does not independently certify that original bound.
